bandReport.notes: Items 62-95, contiguous, no gaps, no repeats. Item 62 starts whole (with its number) at the top of p28-c1, so nothing carries over from p26; item 95 ends whole at the foot of p38-c2 ('[ P.T.O.'). All six pages are English. COLUMN CROPS: split is clean on every page; no question text crosses the gutter. On p30-c2 the left edge carries clipped word-endings from the left column (item 68's line ends: 'in', 'en', 'ss', 'B', 'off' ...); these belong to item 68, which is whole in p30-c1, and were ignored. On p30-c1 only the folio '31' is clipped at the right edge. Faint Hindi show-through on most crops ignored. FIDELITY: the booklet prints decimals with a raised dot (f/g = 1·5 in item 64), recorded as 1.5. Item 62 prints 'nearest minutes' (plural) and item 65 'identical calendar with the year 2025', transcribed as printed. Item 66 prints 'from opposite direction', as printed. Item 70 prints 'tenth place' / 'hundredth place' (meaning tens/hundreds), as printed. Item 78 pairs use en dashes as printed ('NW–1'), written as plain lines with the 'NW No. : River' header, following the 2026 example's pairs format (item 73 there). Items 73 and 76 options print '1 and 2' etc. without 'only', as printed. No figure items in this band. CLASSIFICATION judgement calls: 68 (bulb on/off cycles) under General Mental Ability / Logical Puzzles; 79 (Punjab plantation project) under Environment and Ecology / Forests and Natural Resource Management; 80 and 81 (raster data, GIS components) under Geography / Maps, Longitudes, and Time Zones with an own subtopic 'Remote Sensing and GIS'; 83 (founding order of institutes) under History / Miscellaneous Historical Areas with own subtopic 'Post-Independence Institutions'; 82 (Bharatmala) and 84 (Jal Jeevan Mission) under Current Affairs and IR / Government Schemes and Programmes.
